nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Canonical domain glossary for Ivy Engine: preferred names for audio, visuals, cameras, content projects, and deploy packages, plus terms to avoid and the engine-v1 freeze note.
nodes.languageNotes: Each term is a bold heading with a one-line definition and an Avoid list so agents keep vocabulary consistent.

nodes.name: IvyEngine.sln
nodes.summary: Visual Studio 2022 solution that builds the IvyEngine editor and IvyEngineRuntime deploy-host C++ projects for Debug and Release on x64 and Win32.
nodes.languageNotes: Solution Format Version 12.00; two vcproj entries with matching Debug/Release x64 and x86 mappings.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Bilingual project overview covering the D3D11 renderer, ImGui editor, physics, job system, C++ DLL scripting, and one-click deploy, plus Visual Studio 2022 build steps and links to engine docs.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrored English and Japanese sections; points builders at IvyEngine.sln and the docs/ manuals.
